definition: The StandardRef column of the expanded NRSV-based TVTMS edition in Older Formats at the pinned commit. Preserve its numeric subverse discriminator, including zero. For recognized USFM book codes store BOOK.chapter.verse[.segment]. Unsupported titles, codes and compounds require explicit review. The StandardRef in a rule is not evidence of applicability to an edition by itself.

optional_paratext.disposition: Excluded. The repository identifies a software licence. No edition-specific Paratext input, pinned file rights receipt or separate applicability review has been admitted.
